snapshots.name: positions
snapshots.meaning: the 17 community areas whose edges (3184 directed segments, shuffled by a fixed stride) are the input

snapshots.name: ringAreas
snapshots.meaning: signed shoelace area of each ring in m² (counter-clockwise positive)

snapshots.name: ringIsHole
snapshots.meaning: 1 when the ring is a hole, 0 for a shell

snapshots.name: ringPositions
snapshots.meaning: closed rings after shared borders cancel, UTM 16N metres; offsets past the ring count repeat the last one, so unused slots are empty
